proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9502 *bhiyajyate gives Bengali bhijā, Maithili bhijlāh and Bhojpuri bhījal alongside the widespread bhij- “get wet” verb. These simple participial/result forms express wetness; no opaque auxiliary or compound response is treated as an inherited stem.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5731.1 tala explicitly includes adverbial Nepali tala, Bengali/Assamese tale, Bhojpuri tar and Hindi tar/tare/tale “below”. This is the base/bottom noun used as an adverb; doubled-l forms that may select *talla are not included.
